# Feature Map — Index

Sitemap of features from the user's perspective. Each PR that changes a
route, selector, contract, or state machine must update the matching entry
in the same commit.

| Feature (user language) | File | Surface | Last verified (commit, verdict) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | `docs/feature-map/<feature>.md` | | |

Leave rows empty rather than inventing features. Seed only features that
the repository actually exposes and that an agent can drive.
